name: Zidane hair gate
about: Run: gaw gate --spec skills/gaw/references/zidane-hair-gate.json --out-dir NEW_DIR CANDIDATE.glb (from the Modding folder). Stock passes against itself; every rule is relative to stock, so a version is judged against what the game already shows.

rules.id: no layer-direction-cut box stock does not show
rules.why: straight cuts across the strand flow where cards meet, compared edge by edge with stock's picture: a box counts when stock shows no edge on 60% of the cut's pixels, or the cut steps over 10 Lab harder than stock's edge there. Card-overlap and silhouette edges stock shows as hard do not count. Calibrated 2026-11-17: stock 0 new, v3 5, v4 12, v5 4, v6 1, v7 1, w0 2, w0c 0 (replaces the old count-only rule, which passed v3 and v5)
same, as a share of the card edges
flush card edges with a colour step and strands running across them (the hard cuts the layer test misses)
fine wood-grain stripes where stock has broad locks

rules.id: no new cut, smear or flat box at marks 1 4 6 7 8 9
rules.why: the user's marks: a hit means more boxes of these kinds than stock has in the same circle

rules.id: no new card-edge box at marks 4 7 8 (circles widened 30 px)
rules.why: the hard cuts the user marked: the circles sit up to about 27 px beside the cut, so they are widened

rules.id: no new card-edge box at marks 2 3 6
rules.why: places the user marked that are not cuts; a box here would be a false alarm

rules.id: no new speck box at marks 2 3 4 5 8
rules.why: dots, dither and cut-off shards at the user's marks
